Ex Parte M Zielonacki Judicis Terrestris Calissiensis contra JM Prusimski Capitaneum Nieszczevicen[sem] Relatio

translation.en:
On behalf of the Illustrious Zielonacki, Judge of the Kalisz Land Court, against the Illustrious Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — a Report

Let there be seen at this place a Report on behalf of the Illustrious Stefan Zielonacki, Judge of the Kalisz Land Court, against the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — for the Term of the Condescension in the settlement of the estates of Grab, being conducted, upcoming — as the copy in the submitted documents [attests].

Let there be seen at this place a Report on behalf of the Illustrious Stefan Zielonacki, Judge of the Kalisz Land Court, against the Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — for the Term of the Condescension in the settlement of the estates of Grab, being conducted, upcoming — as the copy in the submitted documents [attests].
summary_en: In 1781 Stefan Zielonacki, judge of the Kalisz land court, obtained a citation against Antoni Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice and owner of Trąbczyn, for the sitting on the ground of the estate of Grab; a copy of the report of it was among the documents produced at Konin.
summary_de: Registervermerk von 1781: Bericht über die Ladung, die Stefan Zielonacki, Richter des Kalischer Landgerichts, gegen Antoni Prusimski, Starost von Niszczewice, zum Ortstermin auf dem Grund des Gutes Grab erwirkt hat; eine Abschrift liegt bei den vorgelegten Schriftstücken.
